effect.name: Whirl and Pinch
effect.description: Creates a whirl and pinch effect.
effect.author: frei0r

parameter.name: Whirl
parameter.comment: Amount of whirl. 0 means -720 degrees, 0.5 is neutral (no whirl), 1 means +720 degrees.

parameter.name: Pinch
parameter.comment: Amount of pinching. 0 means pinch out, 0.5 is neutral (no pinch), 1 means pinch in.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.comment: Radius. 1 means the entire frame is affected.'
